title: Unified Potato Theory (UPT) — Recovered Theory and Calculable EFT Programme
status: high-priority conversation archaeology + developed effective-field-theory programme; not a validated physical theory
abstract: Unified Potato Theory is the earliest recovered Tim Dooley proposal that attempts to place a distinct Potato sector inside an explicit action containing gravity, Standard Model matter, a nonlocal or fractional kinetic operator, a proposed U(1)_potato × Z6 symmetry, Higgs/matter interactions and schematic quantum-gravity extensions. The scientifically valuable core is narrower and stronger than the original totalizing ambition: define one additional field sector precisely enough that its degrees of freedom, symmetries, vacuum, propagator, interaction vertices and observable consequences can be calculated, while GR + the Standard Model are recovered when the new couplings decouple. This redevelopment makes that programme explicit. It separates the historical skeleton from a minimal neutral-scalar EFT and a complex U(1)_P completion; introduces a dimensionally normalized nonlocal kernel K(Box/Lambda^2); derives the quadratic inverse propagator and low-energy expansion; gives vacuum and mass-matrix equations for the scalar-Higgs system; identifies a natural EFT hierarchy and correspondence limits; and defines a model-selection rule requiring the Potato sector to outperform an ordinary singlet or dark-U(1) baseline. UPT is therefore no longer best described as one enormous master equation. It is a staged research programme whose central question is whether the recovered unusual ingredient—especially its fractional/nonlocal dynamics—produces a stable, identifiable and experimentally distinguishable theory.
research_question: Can a minimally completed Potato sector with a precisely defined kinetic kernel and gauge-consistent interactions produce a stable EFT whose observables differ from ordinary scalar or U(1) extensions after all parameters and baselines are treated fairly?
importance: UPT is the earliest recovered project theory with an explicit field, symmetry proposal, Lagrangian and interaction structure. It is therefore the natural place to test whether Potatoverse physical language can become a real calculational theory rather than an expanding analogy.
provenance_rule: The recovered master skeleton, Potato Field P, PSG approximately U(1)_potato x Z6, alpha=1.3 and the named interaction ideas are preserved as project archaeology. Kernel definitions, gauge repairs, dimensional normalization, calculations and experimental contracts below are later scientific redevelopment unless primary sources are recovered.
maturity: T2 effective-field-theory programme; historical action recovered, physical completion unresolved

recovered_user_core.boundary: Several pieces are historically important but schematic or not gauge invariant as written.

A_neutral_scalar.fields: GR + Standard Model + real singlet P
A_neutral_scalar.minimal_action: S=integral d4x sqrt(-g)[R/(16piG)+L_SM+1/2 P K(Box/Lambda^2) P - V(P) - (lambda_HP/2)P^2 H^dagger H]
A_neutral_scalar.scientific_role: smallest calculable descendant and preferred first theory for testing the nonlocal/fractional ingredient

B_complex_U1.fields: GR + Standard Model + complex Phi_P + Abelian A^P_mu
B_complex_U1.scientific_role: smallest completion that makes the historical U(1)_potato and F_P structure literal

nonlocal_kernel_redevelopment.problem: Box^alpha is not a theory until its branch, boundary prescription and normalization are defined.
nonlocal_kernel_redevelopment.general_quadratic_form: S_2=1/2 integral d4x sqrt(-g) P Lambda^2 F_alpha(z) P
nonlocal_kernel_redevelopment.fractional_example: F_alpha(z)=z^alpha[1+c_1 z^-1+...] with alpha=1.3 only inside a declared spectral/Euclidean or causal prescription
nonlocal_kernel_redevelopment.momentum_space_inverse_propagator: Gamma^(2)(p)=Lambda^2 F_alpha(p^2/Lambda^2)+m_P^2 in a translation-invariant flat-background comparator
nonlocal_kernel_redevelopment.propagator: Delta_P(p)=i/[Gamma^(2)(p)+i epsilon] after the analytic prescription is fixed
nonlocal_kernel_redevelopment.low_energy_expansion: If F is analytic near z=0, F(z)=Z z+c_2 z^2+..., giving an ordinary kinetic term plus higher-derivative EFT corrections. A genuinely fractional nonanalytic F has different spectral/causal issues and cannot be treated as the same model.
nonlocal_kernel_redevelopment.spectral_requirement: Locate poles, branch cuts and residues. A physical parameter region must avoid unacceptable negative-norm or exponentially unstable modes inside the claimed EFT regime.
nonlocal_kernel_redevelopment.plain_language: The kernel says how strongly each wavelength/frequency of the Potato field responds. Its pole and branch structure is more physically important than the symbolic exponent by itself.

dimensional_contract.4D_scalar_dimension: [P]=1 for a canonical local scalar in mass units
dimensional_contract.fractional_warning: P Box^alpha P has naive mass dimension 2+2alpha, so alpha=1.3 requires a compensating power of Lambda or a noncanonical field normalization.
dimensional_contract.lesson: The scale Lambda is not optional bookkeeping; it controls both dimensional consistency and where the EFT departs from ordinary local dynamics.

worked_scalar_higgs_sector.potential: V(H,P)=-mu_H^2 H^dagger H+lambda_H(H^dagger H)^2+mu_P^2 P^2/2+lambda_P P^4/4+lambda_HP P^2 H^dagger H/2
worked_scalar_higgs_sector.mass_matrix: M^2=[[2lambda_H v^2, lambda_HP v v_P],[lambda_HP v v_P, 2lambda_P v_P^2]] for the both-vev quartic branch
worked_scalar_higgs_sector.boundedness_tree_level: lambda_H>0, lambda_P>0, lambda_HP>-2sqrt(lambda_H lambda_P) in this normalization
worked_scalar_higgs_sector.plain_language: Before asking whether the Potato field unifies anything, the theory must answer the ordinary questions: what vacuum does it choose, what particles fluctuate around it, what masses do they have, and how strongly do they mix with the observed Higgs?

u1_breaking_sector.kinetic_mixing: -(epsilon/2)B_mu_nu F_P^mu_nu is generally symmetry-allowed and must be included or forbidden by additional structure
u1_breaking_sector.anomaly_rule: If chiral fermions carry U(1)_P charge, all gauge and mixed anomalies must cancel.
u1_breaking_sector.z6_role: Z6 becomes scientific only when a transformation law is supplied, for example Phi_a -> exp(2pi i q_a/6)Phi_a, together with the operators it permits or forbids.

correspondence_and_scale_hierarchy.decoupling_limit: lambda_HP,g_P,epsilon and any matter couplings ->0 with heavy Potato states decoupled gives GR+SM
correspondence_and_scale_hierarchy.local_limit: F_alpha(z)->Zz over the measured low-energy range gives an ordinary scalar kinetic term
correspondence_and_scale_hierarchy.heavy_mass_limit: For m_P much larger than experiment energy, integrate P out and match onto higher-dimensional SM operators
correspondence_and_scale_hierarchy.weak_gravity_limit: g_mu_nu=eta_mu_nu+h_mu_nu with negligible curvature isolates the particle/nonlocal sector before quantum-gravity terms are added
correspondence_and_scale_hierarchy.principle: Each added sector should be tested only after the simpler lower-energy sector is internally consistent.

u1: precision and astrophysical limits depending on mass/couplings
nonlocal: deviation from the matched local scalar EFT
gravity: only after an explicit scalar-curvature coupling is chosen: post-Newtonian, binary, ringdown or cosmological predictions
observable_program.cross_scale: Biology/consciousness requires an explicit coarse-graining map C:microstate->measured biological variables. Shared words such as field, coherence or information are not a coupling.

model_selection_and_novelty_gate.null_B: ordinary dark U(1) with scalar breaking and kinetic mixing
model_selection_and_novelty_gate.UPT_specific_question: Does the fractional/nonlocal kernel or Z6 structure produce a robust observable improvement or new prediction that the corresponding null model cannot absorb?
model_selection_and_novelty_gate.complexity_rule: If the same data are explained equally well after removing the UPT-specific structure, that structure has not earned physical necessity.
model_selection_and_novelty_gate.promotion_rule: Promote only a sector that is mathematically consistent, identifiable and supported by a discriminating calculation or measurement.

failure_conditions: The chosen kernel has unacceptable poles/residues, runaway instabilities or an ill-defined causal/unitary prescription in the regime claimed.
The scalar/gauge vacuum is not bounded or contains tachyonic directions inconsistent with the intended phase.
Interaction operators violate Standard Model or U(1)_P gauge invariance, or anomaly cancellation fails for charged chiral matter.
Current data exclude the claimed parameter region once the actual observables are computed.
The UPT-specific nonlocal/Z6 structure produces no distinguishable consequence beyond a simpler singlet or dark-U(1) model.
Biological or neural claims remain unsubstantiated if no explicit inter-scale map generates successful predictions.

Plot/analyze the corresponding spectral function, poles and branch structure over the EFT regime.

Only if that survives, add the U(1)_P or gravity branch rather than enlarging the master action immediately.
